description: What a *.blocks.json lesson template (in lessons/lessonNN/level_N/) must contain. See docs/blockly_build_plan.md M6 / docs/blockly_blocks_plan.md 4.3.
notes: template_id should be '<lesson_id>/<level_id>', matching the lesson.json entry that points at this file.
steps[].toolbox is a list of block 'type' names from blocks.json — only those blocks are offered in the palette for that step. 'when_run' should be included in at least the first step.
steps[].locked is a list of block ids (Blockly instance ids from the starter workspace, not block types) that the student can't move or delete.
steps[].starter, when present, is a Blockly workspace JSON blob (Blockly.serialization.workspaces.save output) — the blocks already on the canvas when the student opens that step.

A student's saved *.blocks.json file (in their workspace) uses a different, smaller shape: it stores only their per-step workspace + progress, not instructions/toolbox/locked (those come from the template). See docs/blockly_blocks_plan.md 6.2.
